_meta.method: live-walk: /products.json (1992), /collections/all HTML (1987), 5 DB sub-collections; WAF 30-burst on /collections/all + /products.json; runtime grep on worker.ts + product-count-probe.ts
_meta.rule: no DB writes; 400-800ms inter-request delay; if inconclusive say so

corrections.evidence: Live count of <div class="product-card"> wrappers in /collections/all page=1 HTML = 24. Distinct /products/ hrefs on page=1 = 24. R1's '34' came from a slug regex that also matched cross-collection anchors (/collections/<x>/products/<slug>) inflating the count. Theme is click-pagination_mode, 24 cards/page. 1992/24 = 83 HTML pages; walk completed in 83 pages with 1987 unique slugs (~99.7% of /products.json baseline).

siteProfile.perPage (top-level) is the API perPage used by /products.json walks, per product-count-probe.ts:276 (shopify-products-walk reads m.perPage || 250). HTML perPage belongs in paginationPattern.perPage (separate field). R1 conflated the two and emitted 34 in both.

Rule C minimum-cover INTERSECT test: walked 5 DB sub-collections via HTML pagination (all-guns=360, all-ammo-1=350, shooting-miscellaneous-1=168, hunting-accessories=165, magazines-1=79). Union = 1051 unique slugs. ALL 1051 are present in /products.json (1992) AND ALL 1051 are present in /collections/all HTML walk (1987). 0 sub-collection products are outside /collections/all. Conclusion: per-category URLs add ZERO coverage; /collections/all is the 100%-coverage spine. NOTE: sub-collection HTML pagination is soft-capped (all-guns reports 725 products but HTML walk yields only 360) — the cap does not affect coverage because /collections/all does NOT have the cap and reaches 1987 ~= 1992.

Rapid 30-burst on /collections/all: 30/30 = HTTP 200, total elapsed 856ms (avg 28ms/req). Rapid 30-burst on /products.json: 30/30 = HTTP 200, total elapsed 1271ms. cf-ray present, server=cloudflare. Cookies set: ONLY _shopify_y, _shopify_s, _shopify_essential, _shopify_analytics, _shopify_marketing, localization. NONE of cf_clearance, __cf_bm, __cfwaitingroom, cf_chl_* were observed. CF in passive transparent-proxy mode. Operationally hasWaf=false per skill rule.

/products.json walk (limit=250) returns 1992 unique handles (pages 1-7 = 250 each, page 8 = 242). HTML page1 footer literally says 'filters-toolbar__product-count: 1992 products'. DB 1953 is stale (DB lastVerified=2026-04-11; site grew by 39).

product-count-probe.ts:69 (type literal) and :272 (switch case) both use literal 'shopify-products-walk'. The string 'products-json-walk' does not appear in the runtime switch — DB value is label-drift and would fall through to default (no-op).

worker.ts has TWO literal-equality checks: (1) line 397 `verifyMethod !== 'store-api'` (WooCommerce fast-path), (2) line 768 comment documents 'verifyMethod === "detail-page"' as the canonical fallback. Any non-null verifyMethod that is not 'store-api' falls through to verifyProductsViaPlaywright (worker.ts:769). DB 'json-ld' is operationally equivalent (same Playwright fallback path) BUT is label-drift; the canonical/documented value is 'detail-page'. Confidence high on R1 being the documented canonical.
product-count-probe.ts:275 reads m.endpoint with default '/products.json'. Discriminated-union shape requires it. DB freeform shape would fall to the default but emits the wrong method name anyway.

openQuestions.question: 5-product gap between /products.json (1992) and /collections/all HTML walk (1987)
openQuestions.answer: Not material for production. /products.json is the canonical product-count source (productCountMethod.method = shopify-products-walk reads it). HTML walk under-count of 5 is most likely lazy-load tail or theme rendering edge case (some out-of-stock items may not render in HTML grid). Both numbers within 0.25%.
